source.geography: ABS ASGS Edition 3 Local Government Areas 2025
source.note: Seeded from ABS LGA 2025 for South Australia, excluding Unincorporated SA and statistical special-purpose codes. LGA SA markets 68 councils; ABS geographic LGAs here number 70 including Aboriginal land councils. Unincorporated areas: route to SA Health Food Business Notification. NAP and food links verified from council, EHA and ABLIS sources where cited.

unincorporated.label: Outside a council boundary
unincorporated.notes: If the premises is outside a council boundary, or the council has no FBN form, submit SA Health Food Business Notification.

councils.name: City of Adelaide
councils.notes: Nil registration fee for notification. Inspection fees apply for permanent and temporary/mobile premises.

councils.name: Adelaide Hills Council
councils.notes: Home-based businesses named in food-business definition. Temporary stall form published.
councils.postal_address: Adelaide Hills Council, 63 Mount Barker Road, Stirling SA 5152

councils.name: The Barossa Council
councils.notes: New food business notification form and Food Inspection and Fee Policy published.

councils.name: City of Burnside
councils.notes: Food Act enforcement for this council is via Eastern Health Authority (not the council switchboard). Home-based food businesses must contact EHA before commencing.

councils.name: Campbelltown City Council
councils.notes: Food Act enforcement for this council is via Eastern Health Authority (not the council switchboard). Home-based food businesses must contact EHA before commencing.

councils.name: City of Charles Sturt
councils.notes: Nil fee for Food Business Notification. Inspection fees apply (ABLIS 2025–26 schedule).

councils.name: City of Holdfast Bay
councils.notes: Notify 14 days before opening. Separate temporary street traders permit for trading on council land.

councils.name: District Council of Karoonda East Murray
City of Marion
councils.notes: Nil notification fee; inspection fee charged after notification.

councils.name: City of Mount Gambier
councils.notes: Food Business Information Guide published; FBN required before operations including home-based.

councils.name: City of Norwood Payneham & St Peters
councils.notes: Food Act enforcement for this council is via Eastern Health Authority (not the council switchboard). Home-based food businesses must contact EHA before commencing.

councils.name: City of Onkaparinga
councils.notes: Section 86 FBN required before food handling. Nil notification fee.

councils.name: City of Playford
councils.notes: Home kitchens limited to low-risk foods (cakes, biscuits, jams). Temporary event form 14 days prior.

councils.name: City of Prospect
councils.notes: Food Act enforcement for this council is via Eastern Health Authority (not the council switchboard). Home-based food businesses must contact EHA before commencing.

councils.name: City of Salisbury
councils.notes: Notify Public and Environmental Health within 14 days of starting. Home-based food business guidelines published.

councils.name: City of Unley
councils.notes: Notify before commencing or on ownership change. Temporary event stalls need a temporary FBN; markets need a regular FBN.

councils.name: Town of Walkerville
councils.notes: Food Act enforcement for this council is via Eastern Health Authority (not the council switchboard). Home-based food businesses must contact EHA before commencing.

councils.name: City of West Torrens
councils.notes: Home-based businesses must submit FBN; domestic-dwelling premise exemptions available on application.
